CMS, DXPs and MarTech ecosystems</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>QUALITIES AND CHARACTERISTICS</p> <ul> <li>Must come from a strong engineering or development background with deep frontend architecture capability.</li> <li>A naturally curious and experimental mindset with strong opinions around the future of AI-native experiences and modern engineering workflows.</li> <li>Comfortable operating as both a technical architect and client-facing advisor.</li> <li>Low ego, collaborative and delivery-focused, with the ability to inspire through technical credibility rather than hierarchy.</li> <li>A systems thinker who understands the relationship between retrieval, orchestration, rendering and customer experience outcomes.</li> <li>Proactive, resilient and comfortable operating within rapid experimentation cycles and evolving technical landscapes.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex AI systems and engineering decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Passionate about emerging technologies, AI tooling and continuously evolving engineering methodologies.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 300;">We believe great work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. description: <p>London<br>4 days/week in office<br><strong>9 Month Fixed-Term Contract&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Are you a senior analyst who thinks strategically about data and can influence how an organisation uses it to make decisions?</li> <li>Are you someone who can step into an established portfolio of work at pace and set the bar for how we manage data quality, governance and insight?</li> <li>If you've operated at Principal or Lead Analyst level in fintech or a regulated, data-heavy industry, and you're energised by moving between hands-on analysis to acting as a strategic partner to the business, this could be the role.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p> <p>Modulr is the payments automation platform that streamlines money movement with accuracy, control and reliability – built to scale. We process more than 200m transactions and over £180bn in payment value on an annualised basis, and we're trusted by over 6,000 businesses from fast-growing SMEs to global enterprises.</p> <p>We automate how money moves into and out of a business – payroll, supplier payments, spend management and payment collection – through a single platform, connected to the accounting and payroll systems finance teams already use and underpinned by principal memberships of Visa and Mastercard and direct access to central bank infrastructure.</p> <p>As a regulated payments provider with over a decade of experience, we're the platform finance teams trust to run mission-critical operations. Modulr is backed by PayPal, FIS, General Atlantic, Blenheim Chalcot, Frog Capital and Highland Europe, with over 400 employees across London, Edinburgh, Amsterdam and Mumbai.</p> <p>Find out more about us on our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.modulrfinance.com/">website</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.modulrfinance.com/life-at-modulr">careers site</a>.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Data Analysis &amp; Strategic Insight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead the synthesis of complex, multi-source data to drive organisation-wide insight and shape high-level strategic decision-making.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Stakeholder Leadership &amp; Communication</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a trusted voice and influencer across the business, engaging stakeholders directly to shape organisational data strategy and decision-making.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data Governance &amp; Strategy</strong></p> <ul> <li>Provide strategic oversight of data management across Modulr, define governance standards and policy, and contribute to the long-term data strategy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data Quality &amp; Standards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set and champion organisational standards for data modelling, quality assurance, validation, and enrichment — and develop best practice frameworks that others follow.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Data Visualisation &amp; Insight Communication</strong></p> <ul> <li>Set the standard for how we visualise and communicate data insights, leading the strategic direction of the practice across teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Team Leadership &amp; Mentoring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Mentor and develop analysts on the team, building capability and raising the quality of analytical work during a period of leadership transition.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are</strong></p> <p><strong>What you'll need</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience operating at Principal, Lead or Senior Analyst level, ideally within fintech, payments or another regulated, data-intensive industry.</li> <li>A track record of translating complex data into insight that genuinely shapes data-driven decisions across an organisation.</li> <li>Deep expertise in data modelling, quality assurance and visualisation, with the confidence and judgement to set standards rather than just follow them.</li> <li>Strong statistical and analytical grounding — you're comfortable moving between hands-on analysis and strategic oversight.</li> <li>The ability to step into an established team and portfolio of work at short notice, with the confidence to keep initiatives moving without an extended ramp-up period.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience mentoring and developing analytical teams, especially during periods of transition or change.</li> <li>Exposure to high-stakes, high-visibility data challenges in a fast-growing, regulated fintech or financial services business.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ModInclusion</strong></p> <p>At Modulr, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and fostering a culture where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. The merchant experience is only as good as the platform behind it — and most of that experience is the interface itself.

What will you be doing?

  • Setting and driving front-end technical strategy across the Account Experience teams, from architecture and component-system decisions through to hands-on implementation where it counts

  • Owning the architecture of a complex, data-dense merchant platform — the patterns, state management, and performance characteristics that hold up as the surface area grows

  • Holding the experience coherent across Account Setup, Monitors, Workflows, and Auditing — building the shared component and design-system foundations that stop the areas drifting apart

  • Leading engineers across teams without direct authority, through code, design reviews, and technical mentorship that raises the front-end bar around you

  • Owning the things that are easy to neglect: accessibility, performance budgets, and front-end observability as first-class concerns, not afterthoughts

  • Partnering with Product and Design, and with backend engineers across teams, to shape decisions where front-end constraints or opportunities are material

raw.description:
An Introduction to Primer

Primer is the unified infrastructure for global payments. We give finance and payments teams the visibility and control to reduce complexity, improve performance, and capture more revenue - all from a single platform.

Read up on our $100m Series C

Learn more about our culture >

Which team will you be joining?
You're joining the Security team at a critical inflection point. We're standing up dedicated IAM alongside GRC and Workplace Technology, and this role is the connective tissue that makes all three effective.


Every new joiner, internal move, and leaver flows through IAM provisioning. You'll own the day-to-day queue, but you're not just firefighting. You'll be building the automation that shrinks that queue: SCIM-based day-one provisioning, deprovisioning pipelines, access review automation. This is where the long-term leverage lives.


You'll report to the Head of Security and partner closely with the GRC and Workplace Technology teams. Unlike many security roles that sit in isolation, this one is partnership-driven. You'll work with people, engineering, workplace technology, compliance, and the wider infrastructure team to make provisioning and access governance actually work at scale.

What will you be doing?

  • Stabilise and own the IAM request queue as the company scales. You'll inherit an active backlog, understand which requests are genuinely urgent and which are nice-to-have, and establish a baseline for time-to-resolution that holds steady as the company grows.

  • Build and maintain SCIM auto-provisioning flows for day-one account setup across our SaaS tools (Okta, Slack, GitHub, etc.). This is the highest-leverage workload reduction project. You'll own the end-to-end flow from requirements through implementation and troubleshooting.

  • Design and execute the IAM enrolment improvements roadmap, including finalising Mac/Windows enrolment, progressing the Okta rollout, and building the fallback workflows in Tines. You'll work with engineering and infrastructure teams to understand technical dependencies and ship these initiatives on time.

  • Partner with GRC to run automated access reviews and certification campaigns. You'll design the review workflows, maintain the data pipelines, and work toward measurable reduction in standing access and access sprawl.

  • Progress IAM-related technical debt and risk. You'll own JIT/PAM initiatives, least-privilege evidence collection for audits, and the automation roadmap that underpins context-aware access.

  • Remove identity and provisioning load from Workplace Technology, freeing that team to focus on IT support, device management, and people systems.


What we're looking for

  • You've shipped identity or access management systems in production before—whether at a fintech, security-focused company, or infrastructure-heavy environment. You understand Okta (or similar IDPs), SCIM provisioning, access review workflows, and the real-world friction of scaling identity at a growing company.

  • You're equally comfortable building automation (Python, Go, or similar) and integrating tools like Tines, Okta, and cloud IAM services. You don't need to be a security expert, but you need to understand the why behind least-privilege, deprovisioning, and audit trails.

  • You have strong operational ownership. You'll inherit a backlog and make the call on what's urgent, what can wait, and what needs engineering help. You own the queue, not the other way around.

  • You can learn Primer's specific stack and people-systems on the job. What matters is your ability to reason through access problems and translate business requirements into working systems.

  • You collaborate well with non-engineering functions (GRC, People, compliance, engineering). This role sits at the seam between functions; you need to be genuinely curious about what they need and how to help.


You may not like it here

  • We've grown faster than our IAM automation, and you won't fix that in month one. It takes months to ship the automation that shrinks the queue.

  • There's ambiguity on the roadmap. As GRC and Workplace Technology mature, their IAM needs will shift. You'll need to be comfortable reprioritising and re-scoping as the business changes.

  • The leverage is automation, not headcount. You're here to build systems that scale, not to hire a team underneath you.

  • We're remote-first and globally distributed. You'll be the sole person owning this domain. You'll need to document heavily and build trust across asynchronous channels.

  • An interview with the Hiring Manager

  • A final, values-alignment interview

We're building a culture where people can do their best work and be proud of the impact they have. You'll be working with people who are mission-driven, smart, and reflective, and who are genuinely invested in building exceptional products and delivering success for our merchants.

We work remotely, and have done since day one. We believe that building a successful, profitable company goes beyond proximity. raw.title: Senior Manager, Customer Insights
raw.description:
Senior Customer Insights Manager

🌍 Location: London, UK
⭐ Office Policy: 3 days a week in office

Who We Are:

Omaze is reinventing fundraising by giving people the chance to win once-in-a-lifetime prizes while raising millions for charities around the world.

Since launching in the UK in 2020, we’ve become one of the fastest-growing companies in the country, raising over £150 million for charity and creating more than 40 new millionaires. More recently, we’ve successfully expanded into Germany, marking the next chapter in our international growth journey.

As we continue to scale, we’re building a world-class team that will help us better understand our customers, make smarter decisions and maximise our impact across every market.

If you’re excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of a fast growing international business with a powerful purpose, we’d love to hear from you.

🔑 About The Job

We’re looking for an experienced, commercially minded Senior Customer Insights Manager to lead strategic research programmes that influence decisions across Marketing, Growth, Product and Strategy.

As part of our Data, Analytics & Insights team, you’ll work closely with analysts and cross-functional partners to bring together customer research, behavioural insights and commercial data. You’ll turn this evidence into clear, compelling narratives that help teams make better, more customer-centred decisions.

You’ll design and deliver high-impact qualitative and quantitative research across multiple markets. Your work will help us deepen our understanding of our customers, strengthen our brand, optimise our marketing, improve our products and identify new opportunities for growth.

This is a highly strategic role for someone who enjoys solving complex commercial problems, challenging assumptions with evidence and turning insight into action.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Lead strategic research

  • Lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative research initiatives across multiple international markets.

  • Design and deliver research that informs commercial strategy, customer experience, product development and marketing effectiveness.

  • Own strategic research programmes including customer segmentation, proposition development, concept testing, pricing research, brand tracking, creative development and campaign evaluation.

  • Ensure research is methodologically robust and produces clear, commercially actionable recommendations.

Bring deep quantitative expertise

  • Design and oversee robust quantitative studies using techniques such as conjoint analysis, MaxDiff, segmentation, concept testing and advanced survey methodologies.

  • Select the most appropriate research approach for complex commercial questions, combining qualitative and quantitative methods where needed.

  • Work closely with analysts to connect survey findings with behavioural and commercial data.

Partner across the business

  • Act as a trusted insights partner to Marketing, Growth, Product, Strategy and senior leadership.

  • Collaborate with analysts across the Data, Analytics & Insights function to build a holistic understanding of our customers.

  • Help shape business strategy by embedding customer insight into important commercial decisions.

Tell compelling customer stories

  • Ensure the customer’s voice is represented in strategic conversations, helping teams balance commercial objectives with genuine customer understanding.

  • Bring together research findings, behavioural analytics, brand metrics and commercial data to create a coherent view of the customer.

  • Translate complex evidence into engaging presentations and recommendations that inspire action.

  • Present findings confidently to senior stakeholders and influence strategic decisions across the business.

Inform brand and marketing strategy

  • Lead our brand-tracking programme, ensuring brand health and marketing performance are clearly understood and acted upon.

  • Partner with Marketing, Growth, Analytics and econometrics or marketing mix modelling partners to integrate customer insight into marketing-effectiveness measurement.

  • Generate insights that strengthen our brand, improve marketing performance and support customer acquisition and retention.

Champion the voice of the customer

  • Help create a shared understanding of our customers by connecting research, customer feedback, behavioural analytics and commercial performance.

  • Work alongside colleagues responsible for Voice of Customer and customer-sentiment programmes to place ongoing feedback within a broader commercial context.

  • Identify opportunities by synthesising multiple sources of customer evidence into a single, coherent view.

Manage research partners

  • Build strong, productive relationships with external research agencies and suppliers.

  • Write clear briefs and ensure projects are delivered to a high standard, on time and with maximum commercial value.

  • Manage research budgets effectively and ensure our agency partnerships continue to meet the needs of the business.

🤩 About You

  • You’re passionate about understanding customers and believe the best commercial decisions begin with meaningful customer insight.

  • You have extensive experience in customer insight, market research or a related commercial-insights role.

  • You combine strategic thinking with strong commercial judgement and understand how customer insight can improve business performance.

  • You have deep expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methods, including significant experience designing and delivering advanced quantitative studies.

  • You’ve used techniques such as conjoint analysis, MaxDiff, segmentation, concept testing, brand tracking, campaign evaluation and creative testing to solve complex business problems.

  • You have substantial experience partnering with Brand and Marketing teams to inform communications, creative development and brand strategy.

  • You’re an exceptional storyteller who can combine customer research, behavioural analytics and commercial data into narratives that influence decisions and inspire action.

  • You build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders across different functions and levels of seniority.

  • You have a proven track record of managing external research agencies and delivering multiple strategic research programmes at the same time.

  • You enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams and working closely with analysts to develop a complete understanding of customers.

Highly desirable

  • Experience analysing raw quantitative research data using R, Python, SPSS or similar statistical software.

  • Confidence carrying out advanced statistical analysis or collaborating with analysts on deeper data exploration.

  • Experience using external market information and syndicated datasets alongside customer research and internal data.

  • Experience conducting research across multiple international markets.

Bonus points

  • Additional European language skills, particularly German or Spanish.

  • Experience in e-commerce, digital consumer businesses or subscription-based products.

  • Experience spanning both market research and user research.

🙌What’s In It For You

  • Generous stock options scheme

  • Private medical and dental insurance

  • 9% employer pension contributions, when you contribute at least 2%

  • A personal learning and development budget each year to use on training courses, conferences and professional memberships

  • Enhanced family leave policies

  • Life assurance of 4x your salary

Diversity statement

We actively seek out diversity of thought and experience to drive innovation. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and perspectives and work hard to ensure that every Omaze employee can bring their authentic self to work at all times.

title: CRM Director
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About Us</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:280}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p>SharkNinja&nbsp;is a global product design and technology company, with a diversified portfolio of 5-star rated lifestyle solutions that positively&nbsp;impact&nbsp;people’s lives in homes around the world. <strong>Powered by two trusted, global brands, Shark and Ninja</strong>, the company has a proven&nbsp;track record&nbsp;of bringing disruptive innovation to market and developing one consumer product after another has allowed&nbsp;SharkNinja&nbsp;to enter multiple product categories, driving significant growth and market share gains. Headquartered in Needham, Massachusetts with more than&nbsp;4,100&nbsp;associates, the company’s products are sold at key retailers, online and offline, and through distributors around the world.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>AI at SharkNinja </strong></p> <p>At SharkNinja, we’re building an AI-native culture. We’re not waiting for the future; we’re creating it. Our people are expected to experiment boldly, adopt new tools, and continuously raise what’s possible to create meaningful impact for our consumers. If you believe the best way to do your job hasn’t been invented yet, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p>Are you a CRM leader who genuinely *loves* CRM? Someone who lives in the detail, thrives on solving hard problems, and gets a kick out of a challenge nobody else wants to touch?</p> <p>We're looking for a CRM Director to own and drive our Northern Europe CRM Programme — a hands-on, strategic leader who can set the vision across multiple country programmes while staying close enough to the detail to make every campaign, journey, and data flow work brilliantly.</p> <p>This is a pivotal, performance-led role focused on driving revenue through the CRM channel — sweating the customer database, uncovering every opportunity within it, and turning data into growth. You'll bring creativity, a can-do attitude, and real passion — and you'll build a high-performing team that shares it.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own the Northern Europe CRM Programme</strong> – Take full ownership of CRM strategy and delivery across multiple markets, balancing a consistent regional vision with the local nuance each country needs.</li> <li><strong>Revenue driving CRM Strategy</strong> – Develop and execute a roadmap that maximises revenue from the CRM channel, seeking out and unlocking every opportunity in the customer database — the right message to the right customer at the right time, in every country.</li> <li><strong>Automated Personalisation</strong> – Lead the automation of cross-channel messaging across email, SMS, push, and on-site personalisation to create seamless, relevant experiences at scale.</li> <li><strong>Mentor &amp; Grow the Team</strong> – Lead, coach, and develop a team of CRM Executives, upskilling them, setting high standards, and building a genuinely data-driven, high-performing culture.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Market Delivery</strong> – Coordinate and align CRM programmes across countries, sharing best practice, driving consistency where it matters, and localising where it counts.</li> <li><strong>Data-Led, Revenue-Focused Decision Making</strong> – Define the CRM performance and revenue metrics that matter, interrogate the database to spot untapped opportunities, and turn insight into measurable commercial results.</li> <li><strong>CDP &amp; Tech Innovation</strong> – Be the internal expert on Bloomreach, embedding best practice in segmentation, automation, and personalisation.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Collaboration</strong> – Partner with Marketing, Data, and Digital teams to align CRM with wider business objectives and keep everything customer-first.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What You'll Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>A genuine passion for CRM</strong> – You love this discipline, stay on top of what's new, and bring energy and creativity to everything you build.</li> <li><strong>Experienced CRM Leader</strong> – Proven track record in a senior CRM role, ideally in a fast-paced, digital-first or e-commerce environment, managing programmes across multiple markets.</li> <li><strong>Detail-Oriented &amp; Creative</strong> – Equally comfortable setting strategy and rolling your sleeves up in the detail, with the creativity to make campaigns stand out.</li> <li><strong>A Problem Solver with a Can-Do Attitude</strong> – You see obstacles as puzzles to crack, and you love the challenge of getting things done.</li> <li><strong>Bloomreach Expertise</strong> – Extensive hands-on experience with Bloomreach (Exponea) or a similar CDP, and a deep understanding of how to maximise its potential.</li> <li><strong>CDP &amp; Data-Driven Approach</strong> – Strong background in Customer Data Platforms, data analysis, segmentation, and customer insight.</li> <li><strong>Marketing Automation Specialist </strong>– Expertise in automated customer journeys, lifecycle marketing, and CRM campaign optimisation.</li> <li><strong>Omni-Channel CRM Knowledge</strong> – Experience delivering cross-channel CRM strategies integrating email, SMS, push, and paid channels for maximum impact.</li> <li><strong>Performance &amp; Revenue Focus</strong> – A commercial mindset with a track record of driving revenue through CRM, spotting opportunities in the customer database, and treating CRM as a growth channel.</li> <li><strong>Analytical Mindset</strong> – Proficiency in SQL, Power BI, and other reporting tools to extract insight and inform decisions.</li> <li><strong>Strong Communicator &amp; insights</span></li> </ul> <h4><strong>You should apply if:</strong></h4> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You're </span><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">impact driven</span></em><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and eager to have a real positive impact on the company, product, users and very importantly your colleagues as well</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You're </span><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">commercially minded</span></em><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and can put numbers into business perspective</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">You’re as 400;">You're a </span><em><span style="font-weight: 400;">team player</span></em><span style="font-weight: 400;"> whom your colleagues can rely on</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span title: Staff Software Engineer, Continuous Integration
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Anthropic is seeking talented and experienced Software Engineers to join our Continuous Integration (CI) team within the Developer Productivity organization. The CI team is responsible for the infrastructure that enables hundreds of engineers to ship code safely and efficiently to production. By joining this team, you'll have a direct impact on the velocity and reliability of Anthropic's research and product development.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">The CI team manages Anthropic's continuous integration system, which includes:</p> <ul class="[li_&amp;]:mb-0 [li_&amp;]:mt-1 [li_&amp;]:gap-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ul]:pb-1 [&amp;:not(:last-child)_ol]:pb-1 list-disc flex flex-col gap-1 pl-8 mb-3"> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2"><strong>CI infrastructure</strong> for automated testing and code quality assurance across our monorepo, designed to scale with rapid growth</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2"><strong>Test infrastructure</strong> that runs on Kubernetes clusters across multiple cloud providers, handling intelligent test selection, execution, and reporting for a large and complex test suite</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2"><strong>Merge queue management</strong> and complex branching strategies that ensure code quality at scale</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2"><strong>CI tooling and automation</strong> to improve developer productivity and reduce operational overhead</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Design and build highly reliable, scalable CI infrastructure that supports thousands of daily builds across multiple cloud providers</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Develop intelligent test selection systems that reduce CI time while maintaining code quality</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Build and improve incident response automation, including cluster load shedding, automatic recovery, and observability tooling</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Improve test infrastructure reliability through flake detection, quarantine systems, and test state management</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you</strong></h2> <ul> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Have 10+ years of relevant industry experience building and operating large-scale CI/CD systems</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Have deep experience with CI orchestration tools (Buildkite, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar)</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Are obsessed with developer productivity and reducing friction in the software development lifecycle</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Have experience with container orchestration at scale</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Have excellent communication skills and enjoy supporting internal partners</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Care deeply about reliability and building systems that "never fail the same way twice"</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Strong candidates may also have</strong></h2> <ul> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Experience with merge queues and branch management at scale</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Experience with test infrastructure, including intelligent test selection and flake management</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">Experience building CLI tools and developer-facing services</li> <li class="whitespace-normal break-words pl-2">GitHub API and automation experience</li> </ul> <p><strong>Deadline to apply:</strong> None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.&nbsp;</p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£325,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£390,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study:&nbsp;</strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong>&nbsp;We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.&nbsp; Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit&nbsp;<u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u>&nbsp;directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI &amp; Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong>&nbsp;Learn about&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Marketing Manager - Merchant to Consumer
description: <h1><strong>Senior Marketing Manager (Merchant to Consumer)</strong></h1> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>SumUp is building a consumer financial product with a distribution advantage that almost no other fintech can replicate.</p> <p>More than four million merchants use SumUp, and more than a billion consumers come into contact with our products each year. We now have the opportunity to turn that reach into one of the world's largest consumer financial ecosystems.</p> <p>Our consumer product is already live across six European markets. The next challenge is to grow it from an emerging proposition into a product used by millions of consumers, and this role will lead that journey.</p> <p>This role sits at the heart of that growth. As <strong>Senior Marketing Manager (Merchant to Consumer)</strong>, you'll drive the merchant-to-consumer acquisition engine: the channel that converts SumUp's merchant network and their customers into SumUp personal banking customers.&nbsp; This is a rare chance to build a differentiated acquisition channel from scratch inside a small, ambitious team, competing head-to-head with some of the best-funded neobanks in Europe.</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Plan and execute merchant-to-consumer acquisition campaigns across six markets — owning messaging, creative strategy, localisation, and performance reporting</li> <li>Embed consumer sign-up moments into merchant touchpoints, including the super app, card readers, merchant CRM, and merchant website</li> <li>Drive cross-sell from SumUp Local into the consumer banking app, managing conversion, activation, and incentives for consumers coming through merchant-led channels</li> <li>Work closely with teams across Hardware, CRM, and other business lines to get consumer acquisition placements shipped through channels you don't directly own</li> <li>Build and maintain reporting on merchant-to-consumer acquisition performance, using it to inform channel-mix decisions and prove cost-per-customer against direct advertising</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You'll be great for this role if…</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Strong B2C growth or lifecycle marketing experience, ideally in fintech, payments, retail, or a marketplace</li> <li>Proven track record of planning and executing campaigns across multiple markets, including localisation and creative direction</li> <li>Experience marketing through partner or owned channels, such as CRM, in-product surfaces, or point-of-sale,&nbsp; rather than relying solely on paid media</li> <li>Comfort owning acquisition metrics, attribution, and reporting end to end, with a data-driven and commercially minded approach</li> <li>Ability to influence and coordinate across matrixed teams to get placements and campaigns shipped without direct authority</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why you should join SumUp</strong></h2> <p>🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup</p> <p>&nbsp;🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced&nbsp;</p> <p>🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success&nbsp;</p> <p>🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves&nbsp;</p> <p>📚 A dedicated annual L&amp;D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education&nbsp;</p> <p>🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental</p> <p>&nbsp;🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta</p> <p>&nbsp;💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%) 🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary&nbsp;</p> <p>🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service&nbsp;</p> <p>🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team</p> <h2><strong>About SumUp</strong></h2> <p>Be empowered to do more that matters.</p> <p>At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.</p> <p>Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in<a href="https://youtu.be/9DG64C3moeQ?si=YpcWuBNBTOQPzeLI"> our diverse team</a> of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset.<a href="https://www.sumup.com/careers/culture/"> Our core values</a> lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.</p> <p>SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our<a href="https://www.sumup.com/careers/"> careers website</a>, and follow our journey on<a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/sumup/"> LinkedIn</a>,<a href="https://www.instagram.com/insidesumup/"> Instagram</a>, and<a href="https://www.tiktok.com/@insidesumup"> TikTok</a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Support Engineer - EMEA
description: Hello! I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring our first Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉 We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being its first Support Engineer across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process. Not sure which Support role is right for you? We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles. Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes. Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes. Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review. About the role Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect. You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As Ashby’s first Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team. What you’ll own Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved. Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues. Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers. Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback. Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement. Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team. Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence. You should apply if: You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior. You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes. You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly. You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones. You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design. You want to be the first technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team. You should not apply if: You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership. Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deployment—and you haven’t worked extensively with customer-centric SaaS applications, APIs, logs, or data-backed troubleshooting. You prefer to pass difficult issues to another team rather than reproduce, investigate, and explain them yourself. You’re looking for a role focused mainly on writing production code; this role diagnoses and escalates bugs but does not own code changes. You prefer clear-cut problems and predefined answers over working through ambiguity with careful documentation, focused questions, and evidence-based decisions. You want a narrowly defined role without regional operating ownership or projects that improve how the broader Support team works. About Ashby Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com . About Go To Market We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us: We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell. We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers. We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount. We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby. Interview process Our interview process is thorough and designed to give you enough information to assess whether Ashby is the right fit for you, while helping us evaluate technical reasoning, communication precision, and ownership. Intro call with Recruiting — 30 min Take-home assessment — 5 days to complete Hiring Manager interview — 45–60 min Virtual onsite — 120 min Meet the team — 30 min Technical & integration skills — 45 min CS and Support leadership — 30 min Closing questions — 15 min Onboarding Your onboarding will combine Ashby-wide product and company training with a Support Engineering-specific ramp plan. You’ll learn the product and support workflow, get familiar with the tools and systems used for technical investigations, and build relationships across Support, Product, and Engineering. With support from your manager and onboarding buddy, you’ll take on increasingly complex investigations as you build context, with regular check-ins throughout your first 90 days. Benefits Benefits vary by country and are shared in more detail during the process. International employees receive statutory benefits and, where available, employer-paid supplemental health coverage. 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable. Unlimited PTO . Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅 A $1,200 annual learning and professional-development budget. raw.title: Product Support Engineer - EMEA
raw.description:
Hello!

I’m Allie, Head of Support at Ashby. I’m excited to share that we’re hiring our first Product Support Engineer in EMEA 🎉

We’re expanding our global Support team to provide 24/7 coverage across time zones. You’ll join a global team while establishing the technical Support Engineering presence in EMEA, with the ownership and visibility that come from being its first Support Engineer across European time zones. We staff across regions rather than relying on on-call rotations; we’ll discuss the specific schedule for this opening during the process.

Not sure which Support role is right for you?

We’re hiring for both Product Support Specialist and Product Support Engineer roles.

  • Support Specialist owns cases and customer communication end-to-end. Troubleshoots complex issues by navigating internal tooling — audit logs, user experience testing, and API testing — to help customers reach successful outcomes.

  • Support Engineering serves as the escalation point between Support Specialists and Product Engineering. Owns integrations, supports data mapping and data migrations for customers, and resolves escalated tickets that don't require product code changes.

Please choose the role that best reflects your experience and interests rather than applying to both. If another Support role seems like a closer match, we’ll consider that in our review.

About the role

Support Engineering is the technical layer between frontline Support and Engineering. You’ll take on complex issues involving integrations, APIs, permissions, data, reporting, migrations, and workflows—using application behavior, logs, databases, and customer context to determine whether an issue can be resolved through Support or represents a product defect.

You’ll investigate issues end to end using tools such as Plain, GitHub, Datadog, databases, and the codebase. You won’t write the fix; you’ll give Engineering a well-validated escalation with reproduction steps, relevant evidence, customer impact, and a root-cause hypothesis when possible. You’ll also identify recurring issues, improve documentation and enablement, and partner with Product and Engineering on improvements. As Ashby’s first Support Engineer in EMEA, you’ll establish regional operating practices and handoff norms across European time zones while bringing EMEA customer patterns to a global team.

What you’ll own

  • Own complex technical issues from intake through resolution or escalation—investigating APIs, integrations, logs, data, configuration, and workflows to determine whether Support can resolve them or Engineering should be involved.

  • Set a high bar for complex technical investigations and ensure Engineering receives clear, actionable, well-validated product issues.

  • Build trusted working relationships with frontline Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and customers.

  • Identify recurring problems and turn them into documentation, enablement, tooling, process improvements, or product feedback.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering on recurring product improvements by synthesizing customer patterns, validating defects, and sharing the technical context needed to choose between a product change, documentation, tooling, or process improvement.

  • Establish EMEA coverage, handoff, and operating practices across European time zones while bringing regional customer patterns to the global Support Engineering team.

  • Track and improve the outcomes that matter: resolution speed, escalation quality, fewer avoidable Engineering escalations, frontline self-sufficiency, reduced customer effort, and customer confidence.

You should apply if:

  • You’ve worked in a hands-on, customer-centric technical role where you independently investigate ambiguous issues involving APIs, integrations, logs, data, and application behavior.

  • You’re comfortable moving between customer conversations, APIs, logs, databases, product behavior, and code-level context to find root causes.

  • You can distinguish a configuration, data, documentation, or enablement issue from a true product defect—and explain your reasoning clearly.

  • You write precise investigations that others can quickly understand and act on, and communicate thoughtfully with technical and non-technical audiences across time zones.

  • You naturally look beyond the immediate ticket and improve the systems around it through documentation, enablement, tooling, or process design.

  • You want to be the first technical owner for EMEA and are energized by building regional structure within a global team.

You should not apply if:

  • You’re looking primarily for a high-volume support role centered on predefined troubleshooting steps, rather than open-ended technical investigation and ownership.

  • Most of your experience is in internal IT, help desk, endpoint, hardware, network, infrastructure, cloud operations, systems administration, infrastructure maintenance, or service deployment—and you haven’t worked extensively with customer-centric SaaS applications, APIs, logs, or data-backed troubleshooting.

  • You prefer to pass difficult issues to another team rather than reproduce, investigate, and explain them yourself.

  • You’re looking for a role focused mainly on writing production code; this role diagnoses and escalates bugs but does not own code changes.

  • You prefer clear-cut problems and predefined answers over working through ambiguity with careful documentation, focused questions, and evidence-based decisions.

  • You want a narrowly defined role without regional operating ownership or projects that improve how the broader Support team works.

About Ashby

Ashby builds a suite of products that helps talent leaders, recruiters, and hiring managers run their hiring process significantly better. We raised a $50M Series D in July 2025 and support nearly 5,000 customers, including Shopify, Snowflake, OpenAI, Deliveroo, and Confluent. We’re growing much faster than 100% year over year, with a team of roughly 300 people across 22+ countries. Learn more at ashbyhq.com.

About Go To Market

We view our Support team as an extension of the product itself, one that ensures an optimal customer experience for customers ranging across all market segments. Here are a few points that should give you an idea of what it is like to work with us:

  • We spend a lot of time building best-in-class products since we believe a highly differentiated product is easier to sell.

  • We also spend a lot of time building a best-in-class customer experience. We aim to offer deep expertise whenever we interact with prospects and customers.

  • We strongly believe that small teams with very talented people and the right work environment deliver much better performance than teams with large headcount.

We value a strong sense of ownership, principled thinking over experience, and thoughtful communication (we put a lot of effort into using the right communication channels) - we’ll get into these and other values during the hiring process. You can take a look at our Leadership Principles to get a sense of what we value in People Leaders at Ashby.

Interview process

Our interview process is thorough and designed to give you enough information to assess whether Ashby is the right fit for you, while helping us evaluate technical reasoning, communication precision, and ownership.

  • Intro call with Recruiting — 30 min

  • Take-home assessment — 5 days to complete

  • Hiring Manager interview — 45–60 min

  • Virtual onsite — 120 min

    • Meet the team — 30 min

    • Technical & integration skills — 45 min

    • CS and Support leadership — 30 min

    • Closing questions — 15 min

Onboarding

Your onboarding will combine Ashby-wide product and company training with a Support Engineering-specific ramp plan. You’ll learn the product and support workflow, get familiar with the tools and systems used for technical investigations, and build relationships across Support, Product, and Engineering. With support from your manager and onboarding buddy, you’ll take on increasingly complex investigations as you build context, with regular check-ins throughout your first 90 days.

Benefits

Benefits vary by country and are shared in more detail during the process. International employees receive statutory benefits and, where available, employer-paid supplemental health coverage.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited PTO. Expect “Vacation?” in our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • A $1,200 annual learning and professional-development budget.

  • A one-time $2,000 home-office setup budget for furniture, monitors, peripherals, and ergonomic equipment, plus a company-provided laptop.

  • Opportunities to spend time with teammates through an annual company offsite, team offsites, local meetups, and virtual events.

  • Extended health benefits for you and your dependents (subject to availability with our Employer of Record)

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Home Affairs practice are looking challenges and deliver meaningful public value, we would love to hear from you.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be government commercial functions operate, including procurement regulations, governance, approvals, controls and stakeholder dynamics.</li> <li>You have experience of working in complex commercial environments, helping programmes to deliver transformation through procurement activity'</li> <li>You will have experience designing, assessing or improving commercial operating models, including supplier performance improvements or contract management improvements.</li> <li>You will have experience working in complex, high-value, multi-stakeholder environments where commercial, operational, With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Health practice are looking for an experienced Senior Manager to join the team.</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none"><span class="cf0">We are partners in purposeful health transformation, helping organisations deliver rapid, responsible, and integrated change across national, regional, and local health systems. We support major health and care stakeholders, including NHS England, in delivering complex programmes ranging from large-scale technology and data initiatives to critical system procurements and life sciences partnerships. What excites us most is the intersection of the private and public sectors — the point where life sciences innovation meets the everyday realities of frontline care, and where the greatest opportunities for patients are unlocked. As a single firm working across both sides of that boundary, we are able to operate in a far more joined-up way than most: partnering directly with pharmaceutical and life sciences companies as they interface with the health system, and working alongside the health system as it engages with the life sciences companies developing the next generation of treatments.&nbsp;</span></span></span></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>You will work across strategy, delivery, commercial development, and stakeholder orchestration within the UK health and life sciences ecosystem.</li> <li>You will work across the intersection of government, NHS organisations, arm’s length bodies, and the pharmaceutical/life sciences industry, helping translate national strategy into delivery.</li> <li>You will support the implementation of the UK Life Sciences Sector Plan, contributing to programmes spanning health data, clinical research, and innovation.</li> <li>You will help shape and deliver work on health data infrastructure and research services, including national initiatives enabling access to health data for research and innovation.</li> <li>You will contribute to the development of new data-driven health products, platforms, and services, working through questions of how health data assets can best support research and commercial use cases.</li> <li>You will build and develop a pipeline of opportunities across health, life sciences, and government clients, supporting growth of the practice.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>You will support the development of proposals, bids, and commercial propositions, working with senior leaders to shape client solutions.</li> <li>You will play a key role in delivering client programmes, ensuring work moves from strategy through to execution and measurable outcomes.</li> <li>You will act as a connector across stakeholders and institutions, helping align organisations that do not naturally operate in sync.</li> <li>You will support senior stakeholder engagement, including facilitating relationships between government, NHS leaders, and industry partners.</li> <li>You will contribute to commercial growth activities, but within a consulting context focused on shaping and delivering programmes rather than transactional sales.</li> <li>You will work closely with colleagues delivering clinical research, health data, and life sciences transformation programmes, bringing commercial and delivery capability into integrated teams.</li> </ul> description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Transition, Assets and Infrastructure practice are looking for an experienced Manager or Senior Manager to join the team.</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <p>Our Asset &amp; Operations Excellence teams help energy, utilities and industrial clients get more from their physical assets – improving safety, reliability, availability and whole-life cost across the asset lifecycle. We combine deep asset management and engineering expertise with modern enterprise asset management technology and data to help clients move from reactive maintenance to intelligent, insight-led asset management. From shaping maintenance and reliability strategy to implementing platforms such as IBM Maximo and connecting operational technology (OT) with core information technology (IT), we help asset-intensive organisations run their networks and plant more safely, sustainably and cost-effectively.</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>You'll lead the design and delivery of asset management and operational transformations and improvement programs for asset-intensive clients across energy, utilities and major infrastructure companies – including current-state assessment and target operating model design through to implementation and adoption.</li> <li>You will help clients shift to risk/condition based and predictive maintenance strategies driving improvements in asset performance across the whole asset lifecycle.</li> <li>You'll lead providing advisory services related to and optimisation of EAM / CMMS platforms such as IBM Maximo – shaping user requirements, configuration, data migration and integrations with ERP, SCADA, condition monitoring platforms.</li> <li>You'll bring IT and OT together – defining how asset systems, data and cyber-security governance operate end-to-end, and establishing change control, data ownership (RACI) and support models that keep critical systems reliable and secure.</li> <li>You will help clients plan and shape the overall digital, technology, AI landscape for asset optimisation</li> <li>You'll manage day-to-day client relationships and, at Manager / Senior Manager level, hold commercial and delivery accountability for engagements – owning scope, risk, quality and margin.</li> <li>You'll build and coach high-performing teams, developing junior colleagues and creating an inclusive, People First environment.</li> <li>You'll help grow our rapidly expanding asset management and operations practice – shaping propositions, contributing to proposals and building trusted, lasting client relationships.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span></span></h3> <ul> <li>You've built your career in asset management or asset-intensive operations – in energy, utilities, oil and gas, manufacturing or a comparable sector – with a strong grounding in asset lifecycle management and maintenance and reliability principles.</li> <li>You've hands-on experience of Enterprise Asset Management and CMMS platforms such as IBM Maximo, (which may include implementation, configuration or product ownership)</li> <li>You understand how asset management systems connect to the wider technology landscape – ERP, SCADA, condition-based monitoring, data historians and asset / master data – and you can bridge IT and OT to make that ecosystem work.</li> <li>You've a strong appreciation of OT/IT integration and change governance – management of change, change control boards, data governance and RACI, and tiered (L1–L3) support models for critical asset systems.</li> <li>You've delivered change in a consulting, transformation or major-programme environment, comfortable owning workstreams, managing senior stakeholders and turning analysis into practical outcomes that stick.</li> <li>You've excellent analytical, communication and facilitation skills, and you're confident leading workshops and engaging senior client stakeholders.</li> <li>You will have an understanding on how emergent technologies and Artificial Intelligence (AI) is evolving in the asset management and operations arena. It would be desirable but not essential if you have experience in helping companies define and adopt AI solutions</li> <li>You will have, for a Manager / Senior Manager, a track record of leading workstreams or wider engagements end-to-end, potentially including commercials and growing client relationships and teams; recognised asset management credentials (for example IAM certification or familiarity with ISO 55000) are welcome.</li> </ul> <p><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:2,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <h3><br><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. title: Senior Commercial Counsel (Contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Commercial Legal team are looking for an experienced Senior Commercial Counsel to join them for 6 months on a day rate basis.</span></span></h2> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none"><span class="TextRun SCXW129144198 BCX8" lang="EN-GB" data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW129144198 BCX8">Commercial Legal partners with the business, providing specialised legal, commercial and risk management support to enable confident growth. Everything from shaping and negotiating client contracts, to data, technology and AI deals, partnerships and contract risk.</span></span><span class="EOP Selected SCXW129144198 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559685&quot;:-284,&quot;335559737&quot;:-755,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></span></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW106526034 BCX8">This role will report into the Commercial Legal Director, working closely with the Legal &amp; Business Integrity and Baringa Enablement teams and wider firm leadership.
